findings.reason: Verified in the diff that the reader thread is started and never joined before the assertion, so an in-flight request's exception can be missed; this is a real but minor test-reliability gap, which is capped at 5 as a test gap.

Verified that lines 256, 262 and 268 call modelSupplier.get() with no null check while the PR's own getSubGroupsCount guard handles that null, so the same concurrent-delete race still NPEs on subgroup listing; a real incomplete fix, though the impact is narrower.
GroupUtils lines 46-57 do lack a null check on parentModel, but this code is untouched by the PR and the race predates it, so it is a pre-existing issue that the PR does not make worse.
The typo in groupUuuids and the stray whitespace and blank line are real but are purely cosmetic style issues in new test code.
